headline: Vaishali Pharma appoints Rohil Sanjay Desai and Ketur Kishor Shah as Independent Directors
hook: Two board seats filled for Vaishali
summary: Vaishali Pharma Limited announced the appointment of Mr. Rohil Sanjay Desai and Mr. Ketur Kishor Shah as Non-Executive Independent Directors, effective November 5, 2026. This corporate governance update fulfills standard board composition requirements. Retail investors should note this routine administrative change has no immediate impact on company financials.
why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with no immediate financial impact

headline: Vaishali Pharma announces board meeting outcome
hook: Board meeting concludes at Vaishali Pharma
summary: Vaishali Pharma Limited held a board meeting on November 5, 2026. The company officially notified the NSE regarding the outcome of this meeting. Investors should review the specific filings on the exchange website for details on any resolutions passed or corporate actions approved.
why_it_matters: Check exchange filings for potential dividend or expansion updates.
